headline: 1 dead, 30 injured as clash erupts over local dominance in Brahmanbaria
summary: Violence broke out between residents of Suryakandi and Dharanti villages in Sarail upazila, reportedly triggered by a dispute over fishing mat payments.
details: A man was killed and at least 30 others were injured during a violent clash between residents of Suryakandi and Dharanti villages in Brahmanbaria's Sarail upazila on Sunday night.
The deceased has been identified as 55-year-old Khadim Mia of Dharanti village. He was declared dead on arrival at the Sarail Upazila Health Complex.
According to police, the clash began around 7:45 PM at Kalikachho Bazar and lasted for approximately three hours until 10:45 PM.
The violence was reportedly triggered by a dispute over payment for fishing mats used in a local wetland, which quickly escalated into a full-scale conflict.
Police noted that the two groups, supporters of Mosharraf and Khadim Mia, had a longstanding rivalry over territorial dominance in the area.

headline_marked: Hundreds of motorcycles [[parade in front of factory]] in Tongi over scrap metal dispute
headline: Hundreds of motorcycles parade in front of factory in Tongi over scrap metal dispute
summary: A large gathering of motorcyclists caused tension in Tongi as groups clashed over the control of scrap materials from a local factory.
details: Hundreds of motorcyclists gathered in front of a factory in Tongi, creating a massive show of force during a dispute over the control of scrap materials.
The situation escalated as competing groups attempted to seize control of the scrap metal, leading to a large-scale mobilization of motorcycles in the area.
Local witnesses reported that the parade of motorcycles was intended to intimidate rivals and assert dominance over the lucrative scrap business.
The sudden influx of hundreds of bikes caused significant traffic congestion and tension in the industrial zone of Tongi.
Law enforcement agencies were alerted to the situation to prevent further clashes and restore order in the vicinity of the factory.
